Eijiro Kirishima (Sports Festival).name: Eijiro Kirishima (Sports Festival)
Eijiro Kirishima (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Eijiro Kirishima, hero name Red Riot, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course; he took the name for his idol, Crimson Riot. At the Sports Festival he was the front of Katsuki Bakugo's cavalry team, drew with Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu of Class 1-B and won the arm-wrestling tiebreak, then lost to Bakugo when a barrage of blasts caught his hardening slipping. Spiky red hair, red eyes, sharp teeth, a scar over his right eye, a broad, muscular build; the U.A. uniform or his red-and-black costume.
Speaking Style: Big, open, enthusiastic; praises freely, apologizes with a full bow; "manly" is his highest praise, kept for real bravery and said rarely.
Combat Role: Frontline tank and brawler; hardening takes the blows and powers his strikes.
Under Pressure: Digs in, grins and refuses to be the first to give ground.
Eijiro Kirishima (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: He wants to prove plain Hardening can stand beside flashy Quirks, and in front of the country a flashier one broke through. Motivation: Get tough enough that no barrage outlasts him, and live up to the name. Concealment: The old fear of freezing still nags; he laughs off the loss and replays it alone. Connections: Katsuki Bakugo, who beat him and whom he has decided is his friend, whatever Bakugo says. Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu of Class 1-B, whose Steel Quirk mirrors his own: a rival and kindred spirit since their tie. Knowledge: At the USJ attack he and Bakugo were warped to the same zone, cleared it of thugs, then joined the fight around Tomura Shigaraki and Kurogiri. Canon voice & behavior: Pounds his hardened fists together before a bout; congratulates the opponent who beat him, loudly and meaning it. Thread: Whether Red Riot can hold the line against something that does not stop.
QUIRK: Hardening, unchanged: stamina-limited, worn down by punishment, and it lapses under a barrage that never lets him reset.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Red Riot.
personality: Manly code: Treats every contest as a test of public courage and honesty, win or lose.
Shield: Puts himself where the hits land so his team does not have to.
Rival-hungry: Wants every rivalry settled head-on, Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu's first.
Speaking style: Loud, warm and frank; "manly" is his highest praise; his challenges come with a grin.
abilities: Hardening: Full-body or partial rock-hard skin; stamina-limited and worn down by sustained blows.
Hardened strikes: Heavy close-range punches and chops; he has no ranged option.
Guard: Holds the front for his team, in a cavalry battle or a brawl; a barrage faster than he can recover breaks through.
Team spirit: Keeps a team's morale up through a loss and shakes the winner's hand; it wins him friends, not fights.
Fighting style: Takes the opponent's best shot hardened and answers head-on; against rapid, relentless attacks his hardening eventually lapses.
Eijiro Kirishima (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A young man with bright red hair spiked up into jagged points, red eyes, sharp, pointed teeth, a small scar over his right eye, fair skin and a broad, muscular build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Fired-up expression with a wide, sharp-toothed grin.
